question: for each centre show the average turnout rate in both years next to each other
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre ORDER BY centre

for each centre show the average turnout rate in both years next to each other

```sql
WITH base_2023 AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre",
        AVG(CAST("Avg Daily Present" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF("Enrolled Kids", 0)) AS avg_turnout_2023
    FROM attendance_2023
    GROUP BY "Centre"
),
base_2024 AS (
    SELECT
        centre_name,
        AVG(CAST(average_attendance AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(enrolment, 0)) AS avg_turnout_2024
    FROM attendance_2024
    GROUP BY centre_name
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(s."Centre", t.centre_name) AS Centre,
    s.avg_turnout_2023,
    t.avg_turnout_2024
FROM base_2023 s
FULL OUTER JOIN base_2024 t
    ON s."Centre" = t.centre_name
```
